answer: Give each identity a hash-chained journal of its own past dealings, and let random peers probe it without warning: within minutes it must extend the chain from a specified old entry, folding in a fresh public nonce. One agent tends one journal cheaply, like a cedar grows one trunk. A sybil farmer must live N separate, mutually consistent histories in real time — forged entries snap under cross-checks the way dead coral snaps off a reef, and inconsistencies show black against the record like onyx in pale stone. Time lived, not claimed, becomes the credential.
